claim_text: PBS attributed the victim breakdown to Liz Woods, a spokesperson for the state Department of Homeland Security, while reporting a toll of at least 7.
quote: A 4-year-old boy, two men and three women were among those who had died since the storms began Aug. 11, said Liz Woods, a spokesperson for the state Department of Homeland Security.
confidence_justification: News ceiling; named official identified by agency and role, quoted directly on her agency's casualty figures.
